extra.message: The application binds to all network interfaces with debug mode enabled. This exposes Werkzeug debugging functionality and sensitive exception details, potentially enabling remote code execution.

The filename supplied to the /lfivuln endpoint is passed directly to open() without restricting it to an allowed directory. Relative traversal sequences or absolute paths can read arbitrary files accessible to the server process.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: An attacker-controlled file is read completely into memory with no size or file-type limit. Selecting a very large file or an endless special file such as /dev/zero can exhaust memory or indefinitely occupy a request worker.

The attacker-controlled imagelink value is used directly as the requests.get() URL. The endpoint can access loopback, private-network, or cloud-metadata services and returns the fetched response to the attacker.

requests.get() buffers the complete attacker-selected response before converting it to text, with no response-size limit. The timeout is an inactivity timeout rather than a total deadline, so large or continuously streaming responses can exhaust memory and request workers.

The username supplied to /sqlivuln is interpolated directly into a SQL statement passed to cursor.execute(). Crafted input can alter the query and disclose database data through techniques such as UNION injection.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

extra.message: Raw SQLite exception text is returned to the remote caller. Attackers can deliberately trigger malformed queries to obtain database implementation and query-structure details useful for refining SQL injection attacks.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: The attacker-controlled mathexp value is concatenated into Jinja template source and subsequently rendered. An attacker can evaluate arbitrary Jinja expressions and escape through exposed Python objects to execute server-side code.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
